versions.content: In case PduR_IpduMTriggerTransmit returns E_NOT_OK for a contained I-PDU, IpduM shall omit this contained I-PDU silently. The associated Container PDU shall be transmitted anyway without the omitted contained I-PDU. All contained I-PDUs behind the skipped one shall be moved up by the size of the omit- ted contained I-PDU including its header.

In case PduR_IpduMTriggerTransmit returns E_NOT_OK for a contained I-PDU, IpduM shall omit this contained I-PDU silently. The associated Container PDU shall be transmitted anyway without the omitted contained I-PDU. All contained I-PDUs behind the skipped one shall be moved up by the size of the omit- ted contained I-PDU including its header.

If a contained I - PDU has IpduMContainedTxPduColle c- tionSemantics set to IPDUM_COLLECT_LAST_IS_BEST , the Container PDU is a s- sembled and if a PduR_IpduMTriggerTransmit returns E_NOT_OK for a contained I - PDU, IpduM shall omit this contained I - PDU silently an d proceed with the assembly of the Container PDU .

If a contained I-PDU has IpduMContainedTxPduCollec- tionSemantics IPDUM_COLLECT_LAST_IS_BEST , the Container PDU is assem- bled and if a PduR_IpduMTriggerTransmit returns E_NOT_OK for a contained I- PDU, IpduM shall omit this contained I-PDU silently and proceed with the assembly of the Container PDU.

If a contained I-PDU has IpduMContainedTxPduCollec- tionSemantics IPDUM_COLLECT_LAST_IS_BEST , the Container PDU is assem- bled and if a PduR_IpduMTriggerTransmit returns E_NOT_OK for a contained I- PDU, IpduM shall omit this contained I-PDU silently and proceed with the assembly of the Container PDU.

If a contained I-PDU has IpduMContainedTxPduCollectionSemantics IPDUM_COLLECT_LAST_IS_BEST, the Container PDU is assembled and if a PduR_IpduMTriggerTransmit returns E_NOT_OK for a contained I-PDU, IpduM shall omit this contained I-PDU silently and proceed with the assembly of the Con- tainer PDU.

If a contained I-PDU has IpduMContainedTxPduCollectionSemantics IPDUM_COLLECT_LAST_IS_BEST , the Container PDU is assembled and if a PduR_IpduMTriggerTransmit returns E_NOT_OK for a contained I-PDU, IpduM shall omit this contained I-PDU silently and proceed with the assembly of the Con- tainer PDU.
